The '''Sobrik Vehicle Depot''' was a refueling depot in [[Sobrik]], a [[City/Legends|city]] controlled by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. The building was originally occupied by [[Fillarik Arms and Demolitions]].
